device.name: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti Laptop GPU

interpretation: Each block is exactly one warp. Every lane performs 512 strictly dependent ld.global.cg.u32 steps, so adding blocks adds independent warp-level memory parallelism without adding instruction-level parallelism inside a chain. clock64 measures per-thread exposed cycles including scheduling; CUDA events measure complete-kernel throughput. Requested Gload/s counts logical u32 requests, not physical L2/DRAM transactions or bytes on the memory bus.
